text:
Ava L.: quick design sync — noticed the schema editor toolbar labels feel ambiguous when you switch between function-def vs structured-output mode. users were confused whether 'Preview' applies to the whole run or just the selected function. can we tighten copy and add an aria hint?
Samir: +1 saw that in user testing. suggestion: change 'Preview' -> 'Run preview' and 'Schema' -> 'Output schema'. short and explicit.
Maya: accessibility nits: the current toolbar buttons use icons only at 16px with no visible focus ring. keyboard users lose context. we should: 1) add aria-labels (e.g., aria-label=\"Run preview for selected invocation\"), 2) increase hit target to 24px, 3) ensure :focus outline meets 3:1 contrast.
Rohit: implementation note — the toolbar is rendered inside the Monaco iframe. adding keyboard handlers will need a small message bridge. can we keep labels visually compact? heavy copy will break tight layouts.
Ava L.: proposal: keep short visible label + a small help tooltip that expands on hover/focus. visible label examples: 'Run' (with chevron when multiple scopes), 'Preview' replaced w/ 'Run preview' only when context is multi-invoke. tooltip text (for devs): \"Runs the selected function or all functions in the current run. Use keyboard shortcut Shift+Enter.\"
Samir: tradeoff seems ok. also recommend microcopy for the run history item timestamp: currently says 'Ran 3s ago' which confused testers — they thought 3 seconds into the run. change to 'Completed 3s ago' or 'Finished 3s ago' when run state = finished.
Maya: another a11y: run history items rely solely on color to indicate failure vs success. need an icon + text label e.g. 'Success'/'Failed' and an aria-live region when status changes.
Rohit: +1 for icons. for perf, we should lazy-load SVG sprite for history list beyond 50 items.
Ava L.: copy tweak request for function-def editor: current placeholder 'args: {}' — testers read this as an empty args object they must fill. change to 'Example args: {"user_id": 1234}' and add small muted helper: 'Use JSON or example YAML'.
Samir: also let's add a small inline 'validate' state for function defs: green check when schema passes quick lint, red underline + tooltip on error. reduces friction in onboarding.
jenkins-bot: build/test pipeline: PR 5421 status: pipeline passed — preview deployed to staging/playground-schema.
Maya: quick accessibility follow-up: when tool-calling modal opens, focus should move into first tabbable control and trap until closed. also ensure Escape closes modal for screen reader users.
Rohit: i'll scope the message bridge and modal focus trap changes in the same sprint, but will break into two PRs: 1) a11y infra + labels, 2) copy + tooltips + svg sprite.
Ava L.: thanks — can we get copy owner for final wording? @Samir can you draft the final strings and drop them into the staging preview by EOD tomorrow? I'll run another 5-min usability pass.
Samir: on it. will post a small diff with updated json copy keys and aria text.
Maya: i'll run the axe scan once staging is up and post the violations thread.
Rohit: tagging the eng-runtime folks FYI in case any runtime hooks need changes for KV cache behavior with new run preview flow.
Ava L.: perfect — closing notes: minimal visible label changes, explicit status text, a11y fixes (focus, aria-live, icons), copy owner @Samir, staging check by @Maya, deploy-bot green. thanks everyone :tada:
